title: Design initiative completion and archive
text: Steer close-out now teaches finishing a strategy doc whose linked items are all done: add a short Close-out note, set State `delivered`, ask the operator, then `yoke strategy doc archive <slug>`. JOURNEYS still owns the fuller completion audit that reconciles delivered scope, evidence and tracked deferrals before that archive, and how it coexists with session Wrapup and successful Blitz automatic execution-document archive. No completed-initiative proof is inferred here.
